name: System Port
description: Bounded system port using durable tasks, evidence, waits, and effects.

stages.title: Inventory compatibility: {goal}
stages.description: Inventory {goal}. Define a journey matrix and explicit behavioral compatibility requirements. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Inventory defines user journeys, compatibility boundaries, and unsupported behavior

stages.title: Port core behavior: {goal}
stages.description: Implement the core behavior in an isolated workspace. Own only the core scope defined in the inventory. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Core implementation maps every assigned journey to a test or documented gap

stages.title: Port interfaces and adapters: {goal}
stages.description: Implement the interfaces in a separate workspace. Own only interface paths assigned by the inventory. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Interface implementation preserves assigned compatibility contracts

stages.title: Integrate port slices: {goal}
stages.description: Act as the sole integration owner. Review both workspace diffs and combine them into one revision with explicit conflict dispositions. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Integration revision incorporates both slices and resolves conflicting assumptions

stages.title: Verify all user journeys: {goal}
stages.description: Run the entire journey matrix on the exact integrated revision and run `{test_command}`. Prepare a PR with the matrix and evidence. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Every inventoried journey has passing evidence or an explicitly documented unsupported gap
